description: Remove one person's access (accepted or pending) to a Proton Drive file or folder; they are not notified. Fails if the address is not a current member or invitee (case-insensitive match). Confirm the email with drive_share_status first. To change a role, revoke and re-invite. To remove everyone use drive_share_remove_all. The server asks the user to approve this itself.

confirmed.description: Optional and ignored: the server asks the user to approve this itself. You do not need to send it.

email.description: Email of the member to remove, as shown by drive_share_status.

path.description: Absolute remote path of the shared item, as used when inviting.

name: drive_share_revoke
title: Revoke member access
